links.outcome: Local diagnostic accuracy of CADx for diminutive rectosigmoid polyps against histopathology
links.effect: Sensitivity 93% (95% CI 87%-97%), specificity 33% (95% CI 22%-46%), PPV 70%, NPV 74%, accuracy 71%; specificity significantly lower than prior studies.
links.quote: The CADx-system demonstrated high sensitivity, but significantly lower specificity compared with prior studies, driven by a high false-positive rate.

screen.reason: Prospective multi-center diagnostic accuracy study evaluating a real-time CADx system for characterization of diminutive polyps during live colonoscopy.
